name: Credit Chit
description: Standard Atlas-sanctioned credit chit accepted across the outpost's vendors and contractors.
role: The common currency of the frontier. Every fountain and sink of the off-chain economy moves it.

artBrief.silhouette: Round coin with a bright rim.
artBrief.detail: A stamped Atlas mark in the center and a white glint on the rim.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Golds #ac7c00, #f8b800 and #f8d878 with a white glint.
artBrief.spriteScale: One cell; drawn as an inventory icon and a dropped item.
